notes: Lighter and smoother: Smart 3D no longer stalls the headset while it computes depth; things you cannot see give their memory back (hidden windows, the tab before, the 3D model with 3D off, the space with the headset off); Aurora textures compressed on the GPU (same picture). Grabbing a window: no dock blink, no push-back; a held screen goes up to 2.4 m and moves 2.5x with your hand, as in Horizon OS. Hands at rest during a film (controllers down) no longer pause it — pinch 1.2 s to use them. Voice hold fixed. Pop-out 3D eases scene cuts. Hide windows button in Environment. Thumbstick scroll is always Wolvic's. Reports now say what was happening at each jerk. (Aurora downloads again.)
